comparator.academicYear: 2026–2027 adopted annual tables; coherent entrant-cohort sequence unresolved
comparator.sourceNotes: The adopted annual tables cannot be combined into one verified entrant-cohort pathway without resolving repeated course codes and alternating replacements. El poder de las palabras, El cuento hispánico and Música y trans-culturación appear in B1 and B2, and two recur as B3 restricted choices. The current B3 table has a5EC research stage and10EC restricted choice rather than the stored15EC abroad allocation. The thesis catalogue requires a research seminar whose approved replacement is unresolved. A coherent180uniqueEC route and its abroad/thesis conditions need exact official clarification; no missing credits or substitutions are invented. Supported non-repeated allocation155EC is a diagnostic subset, not a complete degree or an assertion that the university degree has a25EC shortfall. B1/noncredit/attendance/choice/progression evidence retained.

audience.programmeDescription: Radboud Spanish Language and Culture studies the language, literatures and societies of the Spanish-speaking world. It combines advanced Spanish, linguistic and cultural analysis, regional study and independent research.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The current sources leave material questions about how the published requirements form one complete study pathway. We show only the supported, non-repeated allocation and withhold UCR alternatives while these questions remain unresolved.

curriculum.routeLabel: Supported allocation; complete cohort pathway unresolved
curriculum.limitation: The bachelor is 180 EC. The 155 EC shown here excludes repeated entries across the annual year tables. This does not mean the degree lacks 25 EC: a coherent cohort sequence, alternating courses and the relation between research preparation and study abroad still need clarification. First-year mentoring, the diagnostic Dutch academic-language test and second-year mentoring carry no credits. Attendance and approved minor and free-choice rules also apply.
